sources.snippet: DistilGPT2 DistilGPT2 (short for Distilled-GPT2) is an English-language model pre-trained with the supervision of the smallest version of Generative Pre-trained Transformer 2 (GPT-2). Like GPT-2, DistilGPT2 can be used to generate text. Users of this model card should also consider information about the design, training, and limitations of GPT-2. sources.title: distilgpt2: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview distilgpt2 is a 82-million-parameter English-language text generation model developed by distilbert using knowledge distillation from GPT-2's 124M parameter version. The model is a Transformer-based causal language model trained on OpenWebTextCorpus (an open reproduction of OpenAI's WebText dataset) using byte-level Byte Pair Encoding tokenization.
